module.Title: Safety-Control Challenge
module.Teaching: Combine mode selection, permissives, alarms, and an emergency stop into one equipment decision.
module.ExampleCode: can_start = mode == "AUTO" and level_ok and not emergency_stop
PredictionOptions: AUTO is selected, both permissives are true, and E-stop is inactive
module.PredictionExplanation: All four parts of the and expression must evaluate to True.
module.BrokenCode:
can_start = mode = "AUTO" and door_closed or level_ok and emergency_stop
if can_start
    print("Pump running")
module.DebugPrompt: Repair the comparison, Boolean grouping, emergency-stop logic, colon, and safe branches.
module.RecallPrompt: Rebuild the complete pump safety decision. Use these exact identifiers: can_start, door_closed, emergency_stop, level_ok, mode, print. Use these exact values: "AUTO", "Emergency stop active", "Pump running", "Start blocked".
module.TransferPrompt: Create a fan safety decision using AUTO mode, air_quality_ok, door_closed, and smoke_alarm. Use these exact identifiers: can_start, print. Use these exact values: "Fan running", "Fan start blocked", "Smoke alarm active".
module.PreviewMessage: Chapter 2 complete: safety and alarm logic are active.
